libdeflate 1.26 (tag v1.26), https://github.com/ebiggers/libdeflate, by
Eric Biggers: from its release's tarball libdeflate-1.26.tar.gz (sha256
125856d4656e0feab660f94842f835923410c9281fedbcee64598c918da42b5a), only
the files its compressor is built from, copied unmodified. MIT (COPYING).

PPA uses it for deflate recipe kind 2, encoder 2 (doc/PREFLATE.md): a
stream libdeflate wrote (oxipng writes with it: -o1 is its level 10, -o2
11, -o3 and over 12) is rebuilt by calling it again with the stream's
level. pas/ppaldfc.c builds lib/deflate_compress.c with no C runtime;
nothing else of libdeflate is used (PPA has its own inflate).

libdeflate 1.19 to 1.26 give the same bytes at every level (checked on
the corpus's PNG streams); 1.18 and before sometimes differ, and would be
another variant of encoder 2.

Do not patch these files here: a new release comes in whole, replacing
this directory, and only if it gives the same bytes (or as a new variant).
